study_methods.name: Lecture Only (No Notes)
study_methods.description: Continuous listening to a live or recorded lecture without pausing or transcribing.

study_methods.name: Lecture & Structured Notes
study_methods.description: Active listening combined with synthesizing and structuring notes during presentation.

study_methods.name: Audiobook / Podcast Listening
study_methods.description: Narrated audio content consumed continuously, often during secondary activities.

study_methods.name: Single-Pass Reading (No Notes)
study_methods.description: Reading textbook chapters or articles from start to finish without highlighting or annotation.

study_methods.name: Active Reading & Summary Notes
study_methods.description: Engaged text analysis accompanied by written margin annotations and summary notes.

study_methods.name: Video Lecture (No Interaction)
study_methods.description: Watching instructional recordings at standard speed without active recall pauses.

study_methods.name: Video Lecture & Structured Notes
study_methods.description: Watching instructional recordings while actively pausing and transcribing structured notes.

study_methods.name: Observing Worked Examples
study_methods.description: Reviewing step-by-step solved problem sets or code walkthroughs without writing out steps.
